title: Chats, safety and settings
caption: Part 4: chats, safety and settings in Waypoint. Mira shows how it keeps people safe.
linkedin_text: Part 4 of the Waypoint tour: the 18-plus check, thirty-minute text chats, ending and blocking, reporting, screening before posts go live, the helpline pause, the not-official label, settings, help and deleting your account.

scenes.vo: Hi, I'm Mira. Part four: chats, safety and settings.
scenes.sub: Hi, I'm Mira. Part four: chats, safety and settings.

scenes.vo: You must be eighteen, and agree to the Terms and Guidelines.
scenes.sub: You must be eighteen, and agree to the Terms and Guidelines.

scenes.vo: A match chat is text only, and lasts thirty minutes.
scenes.sub: A match chat is text only, and lasts thirty minutes.

scenes.vo: End it after five minutes, or block at any time, and rate it at the end.
scenes.sub: End it after five minutes, or block at any time, and rate it at the end.

scenes.vo: Report or block any post, message or Moment.
scenes.sub: Report or block any post, message or Moment.

scenes.vo: Posts are screened before they go live. Harassment and hate are refused.
scenes.sub: Posts are screened before they go live. Harassment and hate are refused.

scenes.vo: If a post sounds like a crisis, you see helplines and a pause first.
scenes.sub: If a post sounds like a crisis, you see helplines and a pause first.

scenes.vo: Anything claiming to be Waypoint staff is marked as not official.
scenes.sub: Anything claiming to be Waypoint staff is marked as not official.

scenes.vo: Settings, help, terms and feedback are all in My Waypoints.
scenes.sub: Settings, help, terms and feedback are all in My Waypoints.

scenes.vo: You can delete your account and data from the same place.
scenes.sub: You can delete your account and data from the same place.

scenes.vo: Notifications, update prompts and an offline bar keep you in the loop.
scenes.sub: Notifications, update prompts and an offline bar keep you in the loop.

scenes.vo: Waypoint. Say it once. Free on Google Play, in many Indian and international languages.
